elements.name: young man seen from behind in centre
old boxy cream-coloured country bus side view
low houses with rusty corrugated tin roofs and mud-plastered walls

wrong_setting: The bus is replaced by a single round thatched-roof hut with a wooden door and steps, so the scene reads as a rural homestead instead of a town bus stop. There are no tin-roofed houses, and the overcast flat light does not read as high midday sun.
notes: Regenerate with the cream country bus seen side-on, its door open and bundles on the roof rack, in place of the thatched hut, add low rusty tin-roofed mud houses, and use harsh midday light with short shadows.
